newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray's S.Korean venture to build resin facilities.
newsitem.headline: Toray's S.Korean venture to build resin facilities.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Tuesday that its joint venture in South Korea would invest about 10 billion yen to build facilities for the production of polyacetal resin.
The joint venture, KTP Industries Inc, is 70 percent owned by Korean synthetic fibre and engineering plastics maker Kolon Industries Inc and 30 percent by Toray.
The new facilities will start operating in January 1998 and have a production capacity of 20,000 tonnes per year, Toray said in a statement.
The new investment is in response to growing demand for the material from the electrical, electronics and automobile industries in Asia, the company said.
